name: SRE Engineer Pack
description: Workflows for site reliability engineers: containerized workloads, infrastructure as code, observability, incident response, and reliability engineering at scale.
useCases: Operate containerized workloads with infrastructure as code, observability, and automated delivery.
Respond to incidents with systematic debugging and post-incident hardening.
Validate reliability with load tests, performance tuning, and security hardening.
examplePrompts: This service is paging on latency — walk through the debugging evidence and propose a fix plus alerting improvements.
Review this Kubernetes and Terraform setup for reliability risks before we take on more traffic.
